name: Princess Evangile W Happiness
source: Fandisc of Princess Evangile, composing of 4 after stories for the heroines and 5 short stories for the sub-heroines. Includes part of the original game's common route as a refresher.
translation: 《福音公主的W幸福》是《福音公主》的粉丝向扩展作品，由四篇主要女主角后日谈和五篇次要女主角短篇组成。游戏还收录了原作共通路线的部分内容，方便玩家重温剧情。
